question: Does ritual purity distinction apply to an offering dedicated to supreme brahman?
premises: An offering may be dedicated to supreme brahman.
Ordinarily distinctions of touched and untouched apply.
In such a dedicated offering this distinction does not exist.
inference: Therefore, offerings dedicated to supreme brahman transcend the touched-untouched distinction.
plain_english: In a substance offered to the supreme Brahman, there is no distinction of touched and untouched.
